session.title: Cash desk
session.description: Current session, takings, movements and closing with count.

corrispettivi.title: Daily takings
corrispettivi.description: Daily or monthly takings (Italian corrispettivi) by VAT rate and method, as CSV or JSON.
corrispettivi.disclaimer: Amounts include VAT, split by rate from the price snapshot; refunds are negative. Fiscal compliance of the setup remains the responsibility of the operator and their accountant.
corrispettivi.empty: No takings in the selected period.
corrispettivi.registerNote: Only takings recorded in the sessions of this register: online payments without a session are in the total of all registers.

perm.forbidden: Your role has no access to the cash desk.
perm.reportsForbidden: Your role has no access to reports and exports.
perm.readOnly: Read-only access: you can browse the history but not operate the cash desk.

open.title: Open the cash desk
open.description: No open session. Count the float and open the session to record takings.
open.floatHint: Cash in the drawer at opening.

current.expectedCashHint: Float + cash takings + cash in − cash out
current.noTakings: No takings in this session yet.

movement.title: Cash movement
movement.description: Cash paid in or taken out, always with a reason.

quickPay.title: Take payment for a booking
quickPay.description: Find the booking by code: the proposed amount is the balance due.

close.title: Close cash desk
close.description: Count the money and enter the amounts per method: the difference is computed against the expected amount.

history.title: Session history
history.detailDescription: Closing summary, takings and movements of the session.

validation.amountPositive: The amount must be greater than zero.

registersPage.title: Cash registers
registersPage.description: Cash registers of the establishment: one open session per register, Z closing and reports per register.
registersPage.deleteConfirm: Delete the register “{{name}}”? Only a register that was never used can be deleted.
registersPage.deleteInUse: The register has sessions in its history: you can only deactivate it.
registersPage.readOnly: Read only: only owner and manager manage registers.
registersPage.formDescription: Each register has its own session, float and Z closing.
registersPage.deactivateOpen: Close the open session of this register first.
registersPage.codeHint: Optional: derived from the name when empty.
registersPage.defaultAlwaysActive: The default register always stays active.
